_comment: Text-only tool-call tests for the Commutr Mascot, run by `npm run agent:test` (backend/scripts/elevenlabs-agent.ts). Each checks the agent's next turn makes a real, structured tool call. Costs ElevenLabs credits, no call minutes. Parameter paths are relative to the tool call details (path_params, query_params, body), so webhook body fields are "body.<name>"; inferred from stored test results, not documented.
